comment: Perfboard layout with board-mounted pots, a colour wiring diagram, underside and etched PCB; counted from the populated board and confirmed against the diagram. Three SPST mod switches (Smooth, Bass, Comp). The legend names D1-D7 and D9 but not D8.
uncertain: D8 (row E, right of the 2.2nF): the legend lists D2, 4, 6 as 1N34a and D1, 3, 5, 7, 9 as 1N4001 and omits D8; it is drawn in the same glass/red-band style as D2, D4 and D6, so probably 1N34A
rows: value not given; drawn like the 1N34A diodes D2, D4, D6
